Hi Ravi — great to hear the team found the demo helpful. Short answers up front, then a proposed workshop agenda and attachments.

- Burst capacity: Dedicated customers can enable short-term burst via our "Surge Pool". Bursts are billed hourly against committed capacity; if the burst exceeds a defined threshold for more than 7 days, we recommend either a temporary add-on or a permanent tier lift. Proration for mid-cycle changes is handled pro-rata on calendar days.
- Feature bundles: We model features as either "throughput-included" (counts toward your committed throughput) or "addon" (flat monthly charge). Observability retention above baseline is an addon; function-calling quotas can be included per-seat or as a shared organization pool — we can show both flavors in the workshop.
- Feature gating: Yes — we support environment-scoped gates under Private and Dedicated deployments (staging/prod separation). Hosted API customers get org-level controls by default; Private can be configured per VPC.

Attached: vitalsnext-sku-map-v1.xlsx (draft mapping), redwood-tier-summary.pdf (short reference), and a template mutual-action-plan docx.

Proposed 45-minute workshop (agenda):
1) 10m — goals & success criteria for the pilot
2) 15m — walk SKU map & bundling options (we'll show 3 scenarios)
3) 10m — commercial mechanics (prorate, surge, credits, downgrade rules)
4) 10m — next steps & decision points (who signs, timeline)

Availability: Monday 16th 10:00–11:00 PT or Wednesday 18th 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works best for your procurement and engineering leads?

Ravi / procurement team — looping in a compact pricing sketch ahead of the workshop so procurement has something to react to. High level (month 1):

Scenario A — Compact-Throughput (pilot, 3 months)
- Committed throughput: 200k tokens/day equivalent
- Monthly commit: $18,000
- Burst pool (up to 50% extra) at $60/hr while active
- Observability retention addon: $900/mo

Scenario B — Throughput-Core (stable pilot, 6 months)
- Committed throughput: 350k tokens/day equivalent
- Monthly commit: $30,000
- Burst pool pricing included up to 20% of commit
- Observability retention addon: $900/mo (discounted at 20% if bundled)

Discounts / concessions we can consider for pilot: one-time credit of up to 10% applied to month 1 commit, and an onboarding credit to offset the first month's observability addon. Downgrade rules: customers can step down to the next tier at the next billing cycle without penalty; mid-cycle reductions are prorated but may forfeit onboarding credits.

I've also attached a draft Mutual Action Plan we typically use. We'll finalize numbers in the workshop — if procurement can confirm the internal approval threshold (e.g., $25k/month needs VP sign-off), we can shape the offer accordingly.
